title: Make index rows open their records
summary: Give humans and agents a direct record link from each generated Ideas or Features row while preserving stable IDs and deterministic output.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Cuts the extra step of locating a JSON file by ID.
risks: Links must remain relative to the generated index and escape record text.

evidence.claim: The generated indexes list record IDs, titles, and statuses in plain table cells.
